qaPassed.description: qa phase only. True only when every charter row is pass or a justified n/a and no critical or major bug stays open.

reportPath.description: qa phase only. Path of the QA report, for example dev-tools/qa/qa-report-<branch-slug>.md. The file must exist.

headSha.description: qa phase only. git rev-parse HEAD after QA, including any QA fix commits.

charterRows.description: qa phase only. The number of charter rows. Zero requires exception.

commits.description: qa phase only. Each QA fix commit SHA. An empty array when QA made no commit.

exception.description: qa phase only. One sentence, only when the diff has no runtime effect.
